mapper.sql: select id, project_id, patient_name, eval_date, eval_result, score, evaluator, eval_detail, remark, ai_analysis, ai_measures, ai_model, ai_status, ai_time, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from ai_evaluation_data
mapper.select:
select r.id, r.project_name as projectName, r.research_synopsis as researchSynopsis, r.patient_num as patientNum, r.pending_tasks_num as pendingTasksNum, r.ongoing_tasks_num as ongoingTasksNum, r.completed_tasks_num as completedTasksNum, r.publish_time as publishTime, d.disease_name as diseaseName, (select count(*) from ai_evaluation_data e where e.project_id = r.id) as dataCount from research_info r left join research_diseases d on d.disease_id = r.disease_type_id
r.del_flag = '0' and r.research_status = '1' and r.project_name like concat('%', #{projectName}, '%')
order by r.publish_time desc, r.id desc
mapper.insert: insert into ai_evaluation_data (project_id, patient_name, eval_date, eval_result, score, evaluator, eval_detail, remark, status, create_by, create_time) values (#{projectId}, #{patientName}, #{evalDate}, #{evalResult}, #{score}, #{evaluator}, #{evalDetail}, #{remark}, '0', #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.delete:

#{id}
